scope:
Independent complete-boundary screen of measured ordinary effusion apparatus.
Not a reinterpretation of missing current waveform as a measured wall-plug bill.
primary_source: Van Alphen et al., Chemical Engineering Journal443(2022)136529, doi10.1016/j.cej.2022.136529. Main section2 and SI tablesS2,S4. Three80/20 N2/O2 steady rows,2L/min,135mA. Main reference293.15K,1atm,24L/mol. This is NOT the owner79/21,300K,2700K ideal-heater contract.
conditional_ballast_statement: If reported135mA is the time-mean current through the series25kOhm resistor, mean RI^2>=R mean(I)^2=455.625W. If it is RMS, equality. If it is merely a setting/peak, no such numeric lower bound follows without waveform. Source describes applied current but does not explicitly define this table statistic.
same_current_common_loss_counterfactual_: improvement=1-(Pa+B)/(Pb+B)*(rate_b/rate_a), only when the same B is actually common. Separate current-variance losses need not be identical. Individual lower bounds cannot determine true total-energy ranking.

ballast_replacement_counterfactual.description: An ordinary efficient current regulator at the same measured discharge state would avoid most ballast waste, if it preserved that state. No circuit built and no identical-state control demonstrated. Break-even additional regulator loss below455.625W versus constant135mA ballast, before supply-efficiency differences.

molar_contraction_scope: For dryN2/O2 feed and onlyN2,O2,NO,NO2 outlet with no wall inventory/other species and relaxed measured gas, Fout=Fin/(1+xNO2/2). Derived by summing atom balances. Extra species/wall erosion/sorption or unmeasured outlet flow invalidate exact use; correction here is a conditional bookkeeping sensitivity, not a newly measured rate.
uncertainty: Only3 published runs; ranges/sample SD are not independent-culture-style precision or a systematic calibration confidence interval. No raw voltage/current waveform, meter error or power-supply input exists in supplied source.
NO+NO2 measured downstream can survive NO/NO2 interconversion, but N2O/NO3/N2O5, wall deposits/erosion and sample handling remain unclosed at full-process precision.
Divider partially melted. Stable downstream NOx over65min does not establish material/inventory reset or long-life operation.
Plasma powers and arc attachment differ between devices. Observed energy-per-mole change is not a matched-power isolated quench effect.
Gas supply/compression, MFC, analyzer sample pump, power electronics, cooling fan if added, startup, capture and fertilizer processing are not in discharge SEC. No wall-plug or plant result claimed.
